source: Generated by client/tools/asset_forge/tex_gen.gd (FastNoiseLite + pattern code; fixed seeds)
notes: Tileable 512px detail/normal maps (paving, stone wall, asphalt, grass, roof tiles, plaster, wood, foliage, marble) + contact shadow. Deterministic: scripts/forge_assets.sh regenerates byte-identical files.
Shared material library (vertex-colour tinted, world triplanar): 16 StandardMaterial3D + window glow shader + contact shadow.

Phase 3: D1 L3, D3 L2, D4 L1/L2/L3, D5 L1/L2, D7 L1/L2 re-massed so every level sits in the art-direction height band (tested). 21 building models: one architectural family per district, 3 upgrade levels each. Production-quality target is stylized realism; these are the vertical-slice set (procedural, no sculpted detail).
Board/street/harbour kit: tile slabs, lot pad, unit boxes, street lights, trees, palm, bench, planter, bollard, boats, yacht, pier, fountain, landmark, background blocks, owner flag.
Four pawns with distinct heads (crown, top hat, rook, gem) in the seat colours; rounded die with recessed pips (face mapping tested).
9-slice HUD skins at 2x: primary/secondary/danger/neutral/disabled buttons (+pressed), panels, card, chip.
32 single-colour icons (white, tinted at runtime; details are mask cut-outs). Used in the HUD and as 3D sprites on special tiles and state markers.

Planar-UV variants of four library materials (same textures as GEN-003, no triplanar) used only by the flat static-ground pieces (tile tops, lot pads, ground boxes); MeshMerger writes world-XZ UVs for them. Added for render cost (docs/test-logs/phase2_perf), not for volume.
Low-preset harbour water: same colours as water.gdshader, one ripple term + quay foam, unshaded. Full water shader unchanged for Medium/High.
